_comment: Category and project rules for the carry scout (lib/carryScan/universe.ts, benchmark.ts).
Categories are DeFiLlama api.llama.fi/protocols `category`, joined on the yields `project` slug.
A single-exposure pool must be in categoryAllow; a stable LP (exposure=multi, ilRisk=no) in lpCategoryAllow.
RWA (KYC funds) and Uncollateralized Lending are left out by not being allowed. projectDeny removes a project whatever its category.
benchmark.borrowRateIsAprProjects: DeFiLlama /lendBorrow `apyBaseBorrow` for these projects is the on-chain currentVariableBorrowRate APR, not an APY
(read 2026-10-10: Aave v3 DAI 4.94415 / GHO 4.5 / USDe 6.61321 and SparkLend USDC 4.36881 / PYUSD 4.28875 / DAI 4.43637 equal the on-chain APR to 5 dp).
S3 converts them with aprToApy. Morpho rows are APYs already (3.1028 vs the Morpho API borrowApy 3.1020).

projectDeny.zerobase-cedefi: CeDeFi: yield is earned off-chain (sources report, 2026-10-10)
projectDeny.pendle-v2: Pendle PTs are out of scope for v1 (docs/CARRY_SCOUT.md §7)
